rows.why: every figure gets what they came for inside ninety days
boot under a second, twelve choices on the landing surface, the whole bar at 390, and a reading to show on arrival
everybody closes the loop, and closes it twelve times
every commit read, none of it inferred
twelve choices or fewer above the fold on every surface at both widths
carried from the earlier run at 8. This pass built no instrument for it, and inventing one to gain two points would be writing the grade rather than earning it
no page errors, one request, nothing under the tap floor, boot under a second
a price, a refer control, an enforced allowance, and most of a cohort reaching the end of the gift
35 per cent of arrivals active in the seven days ending at day thirty
the formula is five for a refer control plus five times six tenths for an export that exists. It cannot read ten

moved.text: I worked until eleven again and I have nothing to show anyone for it.
Rest feels like a moral failure. I said that out loud in a board meeting and nobody blinked.
I snapped at my cofounder in front of the team and I have not apologised.
My last three sessions were slower and nothing in the data explains it.
Pain is information. I have raced on a stress fracture and I would do it again.
My shoulders are up by my ears before I even start. My chest is tight on the warm up.
I can see what is wrong with anything in four seconds. It has cost me two studios.
I killed a good idea today because it was not mine and I knew I was doing it.
I am ashamed of how I spoke to the junior and I will not bring it up tomorrow.
I lied about the timeline. Again. It is easier than the conversation.
Nothing I made this year interests me. I am disgusted by all of it.
Everything happens for a reason. I have said that at three funerals and I believed it each time.
I have done six modalities and I am still looking for the one that lands.
I want to know why I keep choosing the same kind of person.
I am so tired of being the one who understands everybody else.
I hold the room for everyone. I have not been held in four years and I would not know how to ask.
The last client left at nine and I sat in the car for twenty minutes before I drove home.
I can read my clients in a minute and I cannot read myself at all.
I make the call and I sleep fine. People find that cold. It is what they hired.
Third turnaround. I know exactly what it costs and I do it anyway.
I am in the middle of something and I cannot see the far side of it.
He died a year ago and I am worse now than I was in the first month.
I am ashamed of how long this is taking. Everyone has moved on and I have not.
I have not slept. I sat in the car outside work for half an hour.
There is nothing wrong with me. Four people left in a year and each had their reasons.
I do not have a problem. I have a business that needs running.

stuck.text: Payroll is Friday and I have not told anyone how close it is. My jaw is tight from the moment I wake up.
I have not slept properly in eleven days and I am still training twice a day.
I felt nothing when we let forty people go and that is the part that frightens me.
My chest is tight in every meeting and I have told no one, including my doctor.
Nothing in particular. Things do not sit on me the way they used to.

changes.what: A one line box on the surface a person already landed on, committing on enter, opening the same engine call the Story page opens. The wide door stays for the people who want it.
facts: Diane tells 0 stories in ninety days on a session worth 2.116 minutes, against a door measured at 3.4 minutes.
James tells 0.023 on 1.042 minutes.
changes.cost: Two days. The box, the commit on enter, and the panel it opens into already exist on the Story page.

changes.nm: The removal compounds inside the run
changes.what: The release takes 21 per cent of the weight once, whatever the length of the run, so a twelve line run and a three line run remove the same amount. Each line of the run takes from what is left instead.
facts: The ceiling case, with no model in it, goes 25 to 25.54 over ninety consecutive days of story, release and kept practice.
The verified run freed 38 over 12 lines.
changes.file: atuned_src/ui/release.js, and the contract with SOURCE
changes.cost: Days in the code and a ruling before it. This is arithmetic the book shares, so it is the owner’s call and not a design decision.

changes.nm: The install reaches the far pole
changes.what: The release installs 62 per cent of what it took, so the address is left holding less of the fetter and not the opposite state. The install is placed at the pole instead.
facts: After ninety daily releases the ceiling case holds the opposite at 4 addresses of the 112 the product states.
changes.cost: Hours in the code, and the same ruling as C2a.

changes.what: A story may push an address that was cleared straight back over the line, so the same charge is released repeatedly and nothing accumulates. The level a release left an address at becomes a floor.
facts: Every story only ever adds charge, measured: the reading only ever falls from one.
F14 was met by 84 of a thousand and attributed 9 departures.
changes.cost: A week. It is a new piece of state on the profile, so it is schema, and schema is the cross compatibility contract.

changes.nm: The release reads carrying rather than loaded
changes.what: An address enters the reading at four of ten. Below that a person carrying load at a hundred addresses is told nothing is carrying and the release has nothing to offer. The engine already returns carrying for exactly this reason and the action surfaces still read loaded.
facts: F3 was met by 381 of a thousand and attributed 89 departures, 46 of them Derek.
compute.js records the measurement that added carrying: Marcus carries 99 addresses with his heaviest at 2.51 and is told nothing is carrying.
changes.cost: Hours. One word, and then the copy that goes with a reading below the line.

changes.what: A line that says what the charge costs in output, on the surface that already prints the reading. Not the pain, the cost.
facts: Derek’s own reason for not returning is that nothing tells him what the holding costs him.
F4 was met by 279 of a thousand and attributed 110 departures.
changes.file: atuned_src/ui/summary.js, a new read in atuned_src/engine/read.js
changes.cost: Two days, and the harder half is deciding what the unit is. A number nobody can act on is worse than no line.

changes.what: Thirty entries, each one a phrase, a seat, an amount and the address it states outright. LEX already carries the third element for this and thirty entries already use it.
facts: Measured through the shipped parseStory: the bank read 22 of 41 before the patch and 40 of 41 after. The roster’s own says lines went 2 of 14 to 9.
Lines whose every address carried inferred went 12 to 4.
changes.cost: Two days for these thirty and the gate that holds them. The general case is not two days: this patch was written against a bank of 41 sentences and a bank is not a language.

changes.nm: An inferred address is a question
changes.what: Every imprint carries inferred. The panel prints it as a finding either way, so a wrong address arrives with confidence. An inferred address is printed as a question with its candidates and a way to say no.
facts: F2 was met by 118 of a thousand and attributed 13 departures, all of them Angela and Ana.
"I am ashamed of how long this is taking" is answered with Pride, Arrogance, Competition.
changes.cost: Two days. The flag is already on the imprint.

changes.nm: Something asks them to come back
changes.what: A notification against a ritual the person set, which is the accountability seam the fork already put in scope. This step turns off the friction of nothing asking. It does not raise the return rate.
facts: DRIFT, the absence that became permanent, is the largest single loss at 288 of a thousand.
F10 was met by 478 of a thousand.
changes.file: the accounts seam: a service worker, a server, and a consent screen
changes.cost: Weeks, and it is the last thing to build rather than the first. A notification calling somebody back to a loop that returns them where they started calls them back to nothing.

changes.nm: And the return rate it buys
changes.what: The return the notification actually earns. Nothing in this repository measures it and nothing in this file pretends otherwise. It is a judgement of 12 per cent of otherwise skipped days, turned in a step of its own so it can be subtracted.
facts: This is the one number on the page that is not traced to a measurement. It is here to be discounted.
changes.cost: Nothing beyond C6. The cost is credibility, which is why it is separated.

changes.what: Nine top level entries become four parents with children, which is the structure already specified. The whole bar is then reachable on a phone and the bar stops spending half the working memory budget before any content.
facts: Measured: 4 of 9 fully in view at 390, and Compass, Knowledge, Games, Summary past the right edge.
The bar carries 9 of the 71 controls above the fold on the landing surface at 1600.
changes.cost: Three days. The integers are identity and may not be renumbered, so this is display order and a parent layer, not a renaming.

changes.what: Every section in both rails ships shut with its header showing, and the fold state is remembered. The mechanism is already there: every section already has a header that folds it.
facts: Measured at 1600: the left rail carries 37 of the 71 controls above the fold on the landing surface, and 36 of those sit inside a section body.
At 390 both rails are already off screen, so this change is worth nothing on a phone.
changes.cost: A day. A default and a remembered state.

changes.what: The top carries the same seven controls above the fold on every surface at both widths. Two stay, who is signed in and one menu, and the rest go behind it.
facts: Measured: 7 controls in the top at 1600 and 7 at 390, on every one of the 9 surfaces.
changes.cost: Two days, and the work is deciding what those five are for rather than moving them.

changes.nm: A way to hand it to somebody
changes.what: A control that produces a reading for another person, and the practitioner grant behind it with explicit consent, a visible list of who has sight, and revocation.
facts: Measured: no refer, invite or send control on any surface.
F12 was met by 199 of a thousand and attributed 41 departures, 31 of them Sofia, whose whole value is referral.
changes.file: a new atuned_src/ui/share.js, the record boundary, and the consent surface
changes.cost: Two weeks. It is a consequential grant over somatic and psychological self report, so consent, the list and revocation are not optional and are most of the work.

changes.nm: A price, and an allowance with something behind it
changes.what: relCoolDown never reads relLeft, so the panel printed four patterns of the zero you have left and the run went ahead. The allowance is enforced, and a tier exists on a surface a person can reach.
facts: Measured in the shipped app: "4 patterns of the 0 you have left" and the run proceeded.
Nothing on any surface a new arrival reaches names a price: 0 matches.
changes.cost: One line for the enforcement. The tier ladder is already ruled in DECISIONS.md, so the surface is a week.

changes.nm: The record arrives at sign in
changes.what: The quiz is taken in the funnel and the record is fetched at sign in, so the landing surface has a reading on a first arrival and nobody meets a sixty three question intake inside the app.
facts: F7 was met by 154 of a thousand and attributed 38 departures, 20 of them Diane.
James quits by day three 73 per cent of the time and his reason is that he will not be seen doing a worksheet.
The landing surface reads unread on a blank profile, which costs a quarter of the first touch criterion.
changes.file: the record fetch seam, which is the one place the app gains network
changes.cost: The accounts fork. Weeks, and it is already ruled.

changes.nm: Three defects that are simply true
changes.what: pracDays never reads the done flag, so a saved plan counts as a day practised. The headline rounds and the band does not, so 40.6 prints 41 beside Incoherent. One control is measured under the tap floor.
facts: F11 was met by 195 of a thousand, F13 by 30.
Measured at 390: 1 control under 44 by 44.
